name: unixstream
description: AF_UNIX on the kernel stack's uipc_usrreq.c (net-mux S4): unixprobe -s binds a path and listens, a child connects and moves 8 KB each way to end of file; a bound stream socket that does not listen refuses a connect (ECONNREFUSED) and a second bind of its name answers EADDRINUSE; a closed socket's name answers ECONNREFUSED; and 20 datagram sockets are bound at once, past the twelve the old descriptor table allowed.  STREAM OK only when none failed.
